patch_list: Adds a "My POIs" screen to the main menu, under My Places: named folders of saved places, kept separate from My Places. Places can be added from My Places or from any point on the map ("Add to My POIs" button).
Forces TomTom's subscription checks to report an active paid plan, hides the trial timeline/paywall and removes the free-trial card.
Enables the full truck vehicle profile (dimensions, weight, ADR, etc.) and stops the app from reverting it to a car profile.
